messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

The target outfit consists of the top, the bottoms, and the footwear. Remove any original clothing or footwear that is not part of this target outfit. Keep all non-clothing attributes unchanged.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please replace the person's entire outfit with the complete outfit shown from the front and back in the reference images, consisting of the top, the bottoms, and the footwear. Remove any original clothing or footwear that is not part of this target outfit. Keep all non-clothing attributes unchanged. The first reference image shows the front view of the complete outfit, and the second shows its back view.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"She stands with one hand on her hip, raises the other hand to touch her hair, then turns her head to the side and brings her hand toward her face.","camera":"Medium shot from behind at roughly waist height, mostly static with slight reframing as she turns.","clothing":"Black sleeveless top with a back graphic and teal high-waisted pants.","hair_color":"Red.","hairstyle":"Red hair pulled up into a high bun with a short nape section.","identity":"A 3D-rendered woman with a slim build, shown from behind and then in profile.","scene":"An outdoor amusement park at dusk with a swing ride on the left and a lighted carousel-style structure on the right."},"uncertain":["Exact facial features are not clearly visible because she is mostly seen from behind or in profile."]}}

arguments.observed_change: The original pink checkered top and yellow/black patterned skirt were replaced with a black sleeveless top and teal high-waisted pants. The top's back shows a graphic, and the pants match the reference color and high-waisted style. Hair, body, pose, scene, and camera remain largely unchanged.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the person's entire outfit with the reference outfit: patterned sleeveless top, teal high-waisted pants, and matching footwear, removing original clothing while preserving non-clothing attributes.
uncertain: Footwear is not visible in the video, so it cannot be confirmed that the reference shoes were applied.
unexpected_changes: The top appears mostly black in the output rather than the light patterned top shown in the reference images.
